title: nocape
description: A Minecraft mod that allows players to hide their layers, creating a cleaner and more personalized experience by removing visible layers such as the armor layer or skin cloak.
body:
inglish:

A Minecraft mod that gives players the ability to hide specific layers, such as the armor layer or the skin cloak, for a more streamlined and customized look. This mod enhances the visual experience by allowing players to remove unwanted layers while maintaining the core appearance of their character.

español:

Un mod para Minecraft que permite a los jugadores ocultar capas específicas, como la capa de la armadura o el manto de la skin, para lograr una apariencia más limpia y personalizada. Este mod mejora la experiencia visual al permitir a los jugadores eliminar capas no deseadas, manteniendo la apariencia principal de su personaje.
